description: This file defines a Java interface named EntityPopulator that declares methods for converting source objects into target entities, possibly with consideration of a MerchantStore context.

classes.name: EntityPopulator
classes.description: A generic Java interface for populating or converting source objects into target entities, with methods supporting an optional MerchantStore context.

methods.name: populateToEntity
methods.description: Converts a source object into a target entity, optionally using MerchantStore info, and may throw a ConversionException.

methods.name: populateToEntity
methods.description: Converts a source object into a target entity without additional context, may throw a ConversionException.
